title: VPN will not connect
steps: Verify that the computer has a working internet connection.
Disconnect and reconnect to the VPN.
Confirm that the correct VPN server is selected.
Restart the VPN client.
Restart the computer if the issue continues.
Contact IT support if authentication continues to fail.

title: Computer cannot connect to Wi-Fi
steps: Confirm that Wi-Fi is enabled on the computer.
Verify that airplane mode is disabled.
Disconnect from the wireless network and reconnect.
Forget the network and enter the password again.
Restart the computer and wireless router.
Contact IT support if other devices can connect but the computer cannot.

title: User cannot sign in because of a password issue
steps: Confirm that Caps Lock is disabled.
Verify that the correct username is being used.
Try signing in through the organization's password reset portal.
Reset the password if necessary.
Wait for account synchronization before trying the new password.
Contact IT support if the account remains locked.

title: Printer is not printing
steps: Confirm that the printer is powered on.
Check whether the printer displays an error message.
Verify that paper and toner are available.
Confirm that the correct printer is selected.
Clear any stuck jobs from the print queue.
Restart the printer and computer.
